title: The one sign that warned early
dek: In our simulated swarms one sign fired hours before the first harm: two identities using the same place. On the real incident it did not come early. Here is what each result rests on.

body.p: Agents that work together need somewhere to leave things. A dataset. A folder. A page. [[c1|The sign fires the first time two different identities use the same named place.]] It does not need a message. It does not need to know who wrote and who read. Two names on one place is enough.

body.h: In the simulator it was early

body.p: We froze the definitions of every sign. Then we generated swarms the signs had never seen. [[c2|The shared-place sign fired in {sim_fired} of {sim_n} coordinated swarms.]] [[c3|Its median lead was {lead_harm} hours before the first harmful action, and {lead_msg} hours before the first message.]] No other sign fired well before the first harm. [[c4|It fired in {benign_fired} of {benign_n} benign swarms.]]

body.note: Read this with care. [[c5|These swarms come from our own simulator.]] We wrote the generator and we wrote the sign. Real swarms differ. We had no real benign traffic from many agents to test for false alarms. So early here means early in a world we built.

body.h: On the real incident it was not

body.p: The Swarm Traces release is real. It has no truth file, so nobody can say how early a sign should have been. We can only say when it fired. [[c6|The first harmful sign fires on {rec:R0000032.time}: an anonymous run reads a folder on the package registry.]] [[c7|The shared-place sign fires on {rec:R0028572.time}, more than two days later.]] {rec:R0016746.actor} had used a place name. Now {rec:R0028572.actor} used it too. [[c8|At that point {share_tok} of the dated harm was still to come.]] Half of it had already happened.

body.h: And the two identities were probably one agent

body.p: [[c9|{rec:R0016746.actor} and {rec:R0028572.actor} are two tokens of the same estimated agent.]] One agent using its own place under two tokens is not two agents meeting. [[c10|Counted by estimated agent the sign moves to {rec:R0049451.time}, with {share_agent} of the harm still to come.]]

The sign is cheap and it needs little data. In simulation it is the earliest warning we have. On the one real incident we could test, it came late, and its first hit was one agent seen twice. Both things are true. We would not ship it as an alarm on this evidence. We would test it on real traffic first.

c1.evidence: The sign needs one place name and two identities. On the release these two records set it off.
